stem: Which question is the student most likely trying to answer with this investigation?

options.label: A
options.text: How many spaghetti noodles will it take to hold up the mass of a penny?

options.label: B
options.text: How much force will it take to break the spaghetti noodle?

options.label: C
options.text: How long should the string that holds the paper cup be in order to support the greatest mass of pennies?

options.label: D
options.text: How does the distance between the two chairs affect the amount of force it takes for the spaghetti noodle to break?

visual_elements: Diagram of two chairs with an uncooked spaghetti noodle tied between them, a string hanging from the noodle, and a paper cup hanging from the string
